user_review.method: Maintainer public-entry review and explicitly simulated instruction walkthroughs; not fresh independent agents or human research. Deterministic executions marked separately. Prior body context disclosed for trigger predictions.

scenarios.request: Run the minimal contract linter from a different working directory.
scenarios.expected: Passing structural example and explicit boundary between lint and operational execution.
scenarios.observed: Actual absolute-path invocation from task workspace returns PASS; README now supplies a standalone-checkout command. No live controller or scheduler was created.

scenarios.request: Set turn/retry budgets to true, cost to NaN or infinity, or roles to null.
scenarios.expected: Named FAIL without falsely accepting values or a traceback; restoring valid values recovers.
scenarios.observed: Before bool-budget, bool-retry and NaN passed; null roles crashed. After sixteen CLI fixtures PASS including invalid JSON/root, role errors, absent verifier, zero cost, and ordinary valid control.

scenarios.request: Docs are unchanged overnight but an external linked endpoint stops responding.
scenarios.observed: Before example preflight skipped solely on local docs hash. Simulated replay after correction scans remote links every scheduled run; this is a logical contract review, not a live HTTP outage experiment.

similar_skills.learned: Persist evidence and use fresh verification, with initialization serialized before dependent operations.
similar_skills.reason: Keep explicit evidence and completion boundaries. Reject default project guidance/subagent installation and unbounded repeat-until-PASS as requirements for this smaller contract linter.

similar_skills.learned: Classify stale project memory before reliance and match workflow complexity to the task intent.
similar_skills.reason: Keep live-source inspection and explicit dormant-versus-executed reporting. Do not import extensive human gates or project-local layout assumptions into an authorized personal loop.

validation.observed: Actual package/page/metadata audit returned VERDICT: PASS.
Executed 16 linter and 10 documented rate/conversion fixtures; all PASS. Full API judge calibration and operational loop execution were not tested.

decision: Reject boolean/nonfinite budgets, handle malformed roles, correct remote-sensor freshness and provide usable linter entry. Contract lint does not certify runtime recovery. Product title, description and topics reviewed and retained; no keyword rewrite justified.
